connector.name: Recon Crypto MCP
connector.registryDescription: Self-custodial crypto portfolio: read EVM DeFi, sign on Ledger via WalletConnect.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package recon-crypto-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the szhygulin account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ETHEREUM_RPC_URL
env.description: Custom Ethereum RPC endpoint (alternative to RPC_PROVIDER + RPC_API_KEY).

env.name: RPC_PROVIDER
env.description: RPC provider name: 'infura' or 'alchemy'. Used together with RPC_API_KEY.

env.name: RPC_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the chosen RPC_PROVIDER.

env.name: ETHERSCAN_API_KEY
env.description: Etherscan API key for contract verification lookups.

env.name: ONEINCH_API_KEY
env.description: 1inch Developer Portal API key. Enables 1inch quote comparison in get_swap_quote.

env.name: WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID
env.description: WalletConnect Cloud project ID. Required for Ledger Live signing via WalletConnect.
